specs.api_key_instructions:
1. Go to hive.adenhq.com
2. Open Settings > Developers
3. Copy your API key
specs.description: API key from the Developers tab in Settings

specs.api_key_instructions:
To set up Airtable API access:
1. Go to https://airtable.com/create/tokens
2. Create a new Personal Access Token
3. Grant scopes: data.records:read, data.records:write, schema.bases:read
4. Select the bases to grant access to
5. Set environment variable:
   export AIRTABLE_PAT=your-personal-access-token
specs.description: Airtable Personal Access Token

specs.api_key_instructions:
To get a NewsData.io API key:
1. Go to https://newsdata.io/
2. Create an account (free tier available)
3. Open your dashboard and find the API key section
4. Copy the API key and store it securely
specs.description: API key for NewsData.io news search

specs.api_key_instructions:
To get a Finlight API key:
1. Go to https://finlight.me/
2. Create an account (free tier available)
3. Open your dashboard and generate an API key
4. Copy the API key and store it securely
specs.description: API key for Finlight news sentiment analysis

specs.api_key_instructions:
To get a Brave Search API key:
1. Go to https://brave.com/search/api/
2. Create a Brave Search API account (or sign in)
3. Choose a plan (Free tier includes 2,000 queries/month)
4. Navigate to the API Keys section in your dashboard
5. Click "Create API Key" and give it a name
6. Copy the API key and store it securely
specs.description: API key for Brave Search

specs.api_key_instructions:
To get a Google Custom Search API key:
1. Go to https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials
2. Create a new project (or select an existing one)
3. Enable the "Custom Search API" from the API Library
4. Go to Credentials > Create Credentials > API Key
5. Copy the generated API key
6. (Recommended) Click "Restrict Key" and limit it to the Custom Search API
7. Store the key securely
specs.description: API key for Google Custom Search

specs.api_key_instructions:
To get a Google Custom Search Engine (CSE) ID:
1. Go to https://programmablesearchengine.google.com/controlpanel/all
2. Click "Add" to create a new search engine
3. Under "What to search", select "Search the entire web"
4. Give your search engine a name (e.g., "Hive Agent Search")
5. Click "Create"
6. Copy the Search Engine ID (cx value) from the overview page
specs.description: Google Custom Search Engine ID

specs.api_key_instructions:
To get an Exa Search API key:
1. Go to https://dashboard.exa.ai/
2. Sign up for an Exa account (or sign in)
3. Navigate to "API Keys" in the dashboard
4. Click "Create new API key"
5. Give your API key a name (e.g., "Hive Agent")
6. Copy the API key and store it securely
Note: Free tier includes 1,000 searches/month.
specs.description: API key for Exa Search

specs.api_key_instructions:
To get a Resend API key:
1. Go to https://resend.com and create an account (or sign in)
2. Navigate to API Keys in the dashboard
3. Click "Create API Key"
4. Give it a name (e.g., "Hive Agent") and choose permissions:
   - "Sending access" is sufficient for most use cases
   - "Full access" if you also need to manage domains
5. Copy the API key (starts with re_)
6. Store it securely - you won't be able to see it again!
7. Note: You'll also need to verify a domain to send emails from custom addresses
specs.description: API key for Resend email service

specs.api_key_instructions: Google OAuth requires OAuth2. Connect via hive.adenhq.com
specs.description: Google OAuth2 access token (via Aden) - used for Gmail, Calendar, Sheets, and Docs

specs.api_key_instructions:
To get a Google Cloud Vision API key:
1. Go to Google Cloud Console (console.cloud.google.com)
2. Create a new project or select existing
3. Go to APIs & Services > Library
4. Search for "Cloud Vision API" and enable it
5. Go to APIs & Services > Credentials
6. Click "Create Credentials" > "API Key"
7. Copy the API key
specs.description: Google Cloud Vision API key for image analysis

specs.api_key_instructions:
To get an Apify API token:
1. Go to https://console.apify.com/account/integrations
2. Copy your personal API token
3. Set the environment variable:
   export APIFY_API_TOKEN=your-api-token
specs.description: Apify API token for running web scraping actors and retrieving datasets

specs.api_key_instructions:
To get an Apollo.io API key:
1. Sign up or log in at https://app.apollo.io/
2. Go to Settings > Integrations > API
3. Click "Connect" to generate your API key
4. Copy the API key

Note: Apollo uses export credits for enrichment:
- Free plan: 10 credits/month
- Basic ($49/user/mo): 1,000 credits/month
- Professional ($79/user/mo): 2,000 credits/month
- Overage: $0.20/credit
specs.description: Apollo.io API key for contact and company data enrichment

specs.api_key_instructions:
To get an Asana personal access token:
1. Go to https://app.asana.com/0/my-apps
2. Click 'Create new token'
3. Give it a name and copy the token
4. Set the environment variable:
   export ASANA_ACCESS_TOKEN=your-pat
specs.description: Asana personal access token for task and project management

specs.api_key_instructions:
To get an Attio API key:
1. Go to Attio Settings > Developers > Access tokens
2. Click "Generate new token"
3. Name your token (e.g., "Hive Agent")
4. Select required scopes:
   - record_permission:read-write
   - object_configuration:read
   - list_entry:read-write
   - list_configuration:read
   - task:read-write
   - user_management:read
5. Copy the generated token
specs.description: Attio API key for CRM integration

specs.api_key_instructions:
To set up AWS S3 API access:
1. Go to AWS IAM > Users > Security credentials
2. Create a new access key
3. Set environment variables:
   export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=your-access-key-id
   export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=your-secret-access-key
   export AWS_REGION=us-east-1
specs.description: AWS Access Key ID for S3 API access

specs.api_key_instructions: See AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID instructions above.
specs.description: AWS Secret Access Key for S3 API access

specs.api_key_instructions:
To set up Azure SQL management API access:
1. Register an app in Azure AD (Entra ID)
2. Assign SQL DB Contributor or Reader role
3. Obtain a token via client credentials flow (scope: https://management.azure.com/.default)
4. Set environment variables:
   export AZURE_SQL_ACCESS_TOKEN=your-bearer-token

specs.api_key_instructions:
To get a Slack App-Level Token (Socket Mode):
1. Open your app at https://api.slack.com/apps
2. Go to "Socket Mode" in the sidebar and enable it
3. Under "Basic Information" → "App-Level Tokens", click "Generate Token and Scopes"
4. Add the scope: connections:write
5. Copy the generated token (starts with xapp-)
6. Under "Event Subscriptions", subscribe your bot to the "message.channels"
   (and/or "message.im") events so replies are delivered
specs.description: Slack App-Level Token for Socket Mode (starts with xapp-)

specs.api_key_instructions:
To set up Snowflake SQL API access:
1. Get your Snowflake account identifier from your account URL
2. Generate a JWT or OAuth token for authentication
3. Set environment variables:
   export SNOWFLAKE_ACCOUNT=your-account-id
   export SNOWFLAKE_TOKEN=your-jwt-or-oauth-token
   export SNOWFLAKE_WAREHOUSE=your-warehouse (optional)
   export SNOWFLAKE_DATABASE=your-database (optional)

specs.api_key_instructions: See SNOWFLAKE_ACCOUNT instructions above.

specs.api_key_instructions:
To get your Stripe API key:
1. Log in to the Stripe Dashboard at https://dashboard.stripe.com
2. Navigate to Developers -> API keys
3. Copy the Secret key (starts with sk_test_ for test mode or sk_live_ for live mode)
Note: Use test keys (sk_test_*) for development to avoid real charges
specs.description: Stripe Secret API Key for authenticating all API requests

specs.api_key_instructions:
To get Supabase credentials:
1. Go to https://supabase.com/dashboard
2. Create a new project or select an existing one
3. Go to Project Settings → API
4. Copy the 'anon' / 'public' key (starts with eyJ...)
5. Copy the Project URL (https://<ref>.supabase.co)
6. Set both environment variables:
   export SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=your-anon-key
   export SUPABASE_URL=https://your-project.supabase.co
specs.description: Supabase anon/public API key (also requires SUPABASE_URL env var)

specs.api_key_instructions:
To get a Telegram Bot Token:
1. Open Telegram and search for @BotFather
2. Send /newbot command
3. Follow the prompts to name your bot
4. Copy the HTTP API token provided
5. Set as TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN environment variable
specs.description: Telegram Bot Token from @BotFather

specs.api_key_instructions:
To set up Terraform Cloud API access:
1. Go to app.terraform.io > User Settings > Tokens
2. Create a new API token
3. Set environment variable:
   export TFC_TOKEN=your-api-token
   (Optional for Terraform Enterprise: export TFC_URL=https://your-host.example.com)

specs.api_key_instructions:

2. Select your Power-Up or create one

specs.api_key_instructions:

2. Copy your Account SID and Auth Token from the dashboard
3. Set environment variables:

specs.api_key_instructions:
To set up X/Twitter API access:
1. Go to https://developer.x.com/en/portal/dashboard
2. Create a Project and App
3. Copy the Bearer Token from the Keys and Tokens tab
4. Set environment variable:
   export X_BEARER_TOKEN=your-bearer-token
specs.description: X/Twitter API v2 Bearer Token (app-only, read access)

specs.api_key_instructions:
To get a Vercel access token:
1. Go to https://vercel.com/account/tokens
2. Click 'Create' to generate a new token
3. Give it a name and set the scope (Full Account recommended)
4. Copy the token
5. Set the environment variable:
   export VERCEL_TOKEN=your-token
specs.description: Vercel access token for deployment and project management

specs.api_key_instructions:
To get a YouTube Data API key:
1. Go to https://console.cloud.google.com/
2. Create a new project or select an existing one
3. Go to APIs & Services > Library
4. Search for "YouTube Data API v3" and enable it
5. Go to APIs & Services > Credentials
6. Click "Create Credentials" > "API key"
7. Copy the API key
8. (Optional) Restrict the key to YouTube Data API v3 only
specs.description: Google API key with YouTube Data API v3 enabled

specs.api_key_instructions:
To set up W&B API access:
1. Create a W&B account at https://wandb.ai
2. Go to https://wandb.ai/authorize
3. Copy your API key
4. Set environment variable:
   export WANDB_API_KEY=your-api-key
specs.description: Weights & Biases API Key

specs.api_key_instructions:
To set up Zendesk API access:
1. Go to Zendesk Admin > Apps and integrations > APIs > Zendesk API
2. Enable Token Access and create an API token
3. Set environment variables:
   export ZENDESK_SUBDOMAIN=your-subdomain
   export ZENDESK_EMAIL=your-email@example.com
   export ZENDESK_API_TOKEN=your-api-token
specs.description: Zendesk subdomain (e.g. 'acme' from acme.zendesk.com)

specs.api_key_instructions:
To get a Zoho CRM access token:
1. Go to https://api-console.zoho.com/
2. Create a Self Client
3. Generate an access token with scope: ZohoCRM.modules.ALL
4. Set environment variables:
   export ZOHO_CRM_ACCESS_TOKEN=your-access-token
   export ZOHO_CRM_DOMAIN=www.zohoapis.com  (or .eu, .in, .com.au, .jp)
specs.description: Zoho CRM OAuth access token (also set ZOHO_CRM_DOMAIN for non-US regions)

specs.api_key_instructions:
To set up Zoom API access:
1. Go to Zoom App Marketplace and create a Server-to-Server OAuth app
2. Add required scopes: user:read, meeting:read, meeting:write, recording:read
3. Generate a token using account_credentials grant type
4. Set environment variable:
   export ZOOM_ACCESS_TOKEN=your-bearer-token
specs.description: Zoom Server-to-Server OAuth access token

specs.api_key_instructions:
To get a Freshdesk API key:
1. Log in to Freshdesk
2. Click your profile avatar (top-right) and select Profile Settings
3. Copy the value under 'Your API Key'
4. Set the environment variable:
   export FRESHDESK_API_KEY=your-api-key
specs.description: Freshdesk API key for ticket, contact, agent, and group management

specs.api_key_instructions:
Set your Freshdesk hostname:
   export FRESHDESK_DOMAIN=acme.freshdesk.com
specs.description: Freshdesk hostname (e.g. acme.freshdesk.com). Required with API key.

skills.description: 管理行为（赫伯特·西蒙《Administrative Behavior》，诺贝尔奖作品）。当用户要理解"有限理性"与"满意准则"（管理人 vs 经济人）、要把决策拆成"事实要素与价值要素"（手段-目的链）、要理解决策的层级系统、要用"诱因-贡献"分析组织均衡、要理解权威与影响/权威的限度、或要理解效率准则与组织认同时，按意图路由到 6 张能力卡。核心定位：决策制定过程是理解组织现象的关键——组织是决策的系统，人是"有限理性"的，不追求最优而追求满意。覆盖：有限理性与满意准则、决策的事实要素与价值要素、决策层级系统、组织均衡（诱因-贡献）、权威的角色、效率准则与组织认同。

skills.description: 通用 AI-agent 编排系统的设计实施规范——把多 agent 协调系统设计成不会误杀、不会泄漏、不会递归失控的工程系统。适用于：设计或评审一套 agent 编排运行时、定义任务/派发/结算的状态模型、排查"agent 消失了怎么办""谁有权停止它""重复执行如何收敛""嵌套派生如何防爆炸"、审查编排协议是否把"不知道"当失败处理。核心是七条可验证的工程不变量：权威来自不可伪造 ID、缺席≠失败、未知是一等状态、结算必须显式定归属、递归深度必须设上限、失败重试必须熔断、资源必须能枚举归零。关键 trigger：编排/编排层/dispatch/派发/结算/settle/围栏/fencing/split-brain/幂等/重放/退避/熔断/circuit breaker/深度上限/nesting/资源泄漏/孤儿任务/孤儿进程/unverifiable/租约/lease/心跳/heartbeat/存活/liveness/多 agent 运行时/协调器/coordinator。何时不用：只判断"该不该开并行"用 ai-native-swarm-skill；只判断"该串行还是并行"用 ai-native-ralph-skill；蒸馏外部书籍用 ai-cangjie-skill。

skills.description:
《学会提问》（Brownne & Keeley，原书第 11 版）论证评价能力卡。
正例：评价一个具体论证的说服力是否成立——从作者／演说者的文本中拆出论题、结论、理由，
查关键术语歧义，挖价值观与描述性假设，按六步流程验谬误，最后用条件句给出可辩护的结论。
触发面：文章、研报、行业结论、方案、广告文案、他人提案的说服力评审与自查。
本书的关键问题共 11 个（ch03–ch13），ch01/ch02 是前置校准；本书的
「批判性思维关键问题」与「论证评价的 11 问」指同一套东西，调用时以「批判性思维」
或「论证评价」限定，不单独使用「关键问题」四字。
近邻负例：
- 只想诊断一段话用词是否准确／是否有大词／是不是伪问题／模型是否形式有效 → 用 tractatus-skill。
- 要验算自己写的逻辑是否形式有效／判断是否重言式 → 用 truth-function / tautology-logic。
- 要在重大决策信息不全期主动减速、安排研究流程 → 用 dynamic-decision-skill。
- 要判定一段表述是否形式上重言 → 用 tautology-logic。
触发词：critical thinking, argument analysis, 论证审计, 论题, 结论, 理由, 假设, 谬误, 条件句。
skills.name: audit-pipeline

skills.description: 深度思考：不断逼近问题的本质——前香奈儿CEO莫琳·希凯的领导力与自我成长方法论。当用户面临重大人生/职业抉择说不清动机、需要说服上级接受非常规提案、要在会议中坚持立场、要练习倾听与管理自己的阴暗面、评审创意产出怕扼杀原创时，按意图路由到 19 张能力卡。覆盖：决策动机反思、数据支撑直觉、坚持立场判据、深度倾听、阴暗面管理、创意简报松绑、职业软因素评估，以及换位思考/语境重构/愿景共创/聚焦目标/逆向澄清/底层学习/乐谱即兴/身体边界/提问式领导/拥抱矛盾/年度词/家庭分工重定义等支撑能力。

skills.description:
为一个因果结论至少列出一个言之有理的替代解释，并按六条标准比较它们的可信度。
批判性思维 / 论证评价场景触发：当材料说「A 导致了 B」「与 B 有关」「A 决定了 B」
「A 增加了 B 的可能」「A 阻止了 B」，或用组间比较、事件先后、单一动机来支撑一个原因时，
用它做三路分流（强因果词 / 弱关联词 / 无标记）、跑替代原因四问、区分「唯一原因」与「原因之一」、
检出相关≠因果 / 事后归因 / 基本归因错误 / 过度简化因果关系。
适用于：事故与业务指标归因、政策效果评估、研究结论解读、新闻复盘、解释某个人的行为。
英文信号：what caused this, correlation vs causation, alternative explanation, rival cause, confounding, post hoc。
何时不用：①要在决策流程中系统检验竞争性假设（ACH / 正反分析）→ 用 dynamic-decision-skill；
②要查数据是否骗人（平均值口径、来源、偏见、分母）或被省略了什么 → 用本书第 9、10 问；
③要查循环论证 / 稻草人 / 虚假两难等论证形式谬误 → 用本书第 5 问；
④材料中没有任何因果或相关主张 → 本卡不启动。
本卡只降低置信度，永不输出「该论证正确」。

# 管理行为：有限理性与决策制定 — 全书能力入口

> 本书回答：**组织是什么？如何理解组织中的人如何做决策？** 答案 = 决策制定过程是理解组织现象的关键；人是"有限理性"的，不追求最优而追求满意。

## 触发与不触发

**适用**：与本书能力域相关的组织决策/理性/权威咨询（见路由表意图列）。
**不适用**：
- 纯经济学"经济人"最优化模型（本书立场相反：现实人是"有限理性"的"管理人"）
- 纯信息查询 / 量化优化
- 已明确要"追求最优解"且拒绝"满意准则"视角

## 核心原则（常驻速览）

1. 组织不是"信息处理机器"，而是决策制定的系统——理解组织现象的关键是决策制定过程
2. 经济人追求"最优"（从所有备选方案中选最好的）；管理人追求"满意"（寻找"足够好即可"的行动方案）
3. 有限理性 = 知识与计算能力的限制——"组织里的行为是有意理性的，但只是有限的理性"
4. "市场份额""合理利润""公平价格"都是满意准则，商人耳熟能详，经济学家却陌生
5. 决策包含事实要素（真伪可判断）与价值要素（好坏需价值判断），二者常混在一起
6. 手段-目的层级：每一层相对其下层是目的，相对上层是手段；理性体现在不完整、不一致的层级中
7. 组织均衡 = 诱因与贡献的平衡——"除非诱因与利益能实现均衡，否则组织无法生存"
8. 权威 ≠ 影响；权威有"限度"，…[+1193 chars sha256:164d8fee2012]
